themes.title: Sweeteners and added sugar
themes.why: Sweetener rules reach both low-sugar claims and school channel sales, so one product can be exposed twice.
themes.action: Confirm sweetener disclosures and watch the regional bills.

themes.title: Allergen declarations
themes.why: An allergen order changes label artwork for every pack that contains a named allergen.
themes.action: Inventory allergen content by product and schedule label updates.
